name: Place value and digit positions
definition: A digit's value depends on where it sits in the number. The 4 in 47 means forty, while the 4 in 74 means four. Problems about digits ask about the symbols in each position, not about the size of the whole number.
recognizeWhen: the problem names the tens digit or the ones digit
two digits get swapped and you compare the new number
a digit is crossed out, moved, or added on the end
the problem describes a number by its digits instead of its value
misconceptions: I read 47 and 74 as the same number because they use the same digits.
I thought the tens digit of 305 was 3, because 3 is the tens-looking one.
I added the digits together when the question asked for the number.
